payload.summary: Forms attachment row collapses on a phone: the form title renders as 'Ext...'
payload.detail: /forms/extension-transport-order at 320 and 390: title truncates to three characters, publisher to 'Offic...', and the restriction sentence breaks one word per line while two status badges sit across it. form-detail-page.tsx:844-890 - the phone badge row takes its natural width beside a text column allowed to collapse to ~55px. 'Password required' and 'Editing restricted' decide whether the clinician can fill the form now or must print it, on a Mental Health Act transport order.
